lines: I should get back before that <pulse>plate</pulse> cools wrong.
That cuirass will not fit itself, and the <pulse>hammer</pulse> is still warm.
The smithy will be wondering where I wandered off to.
I have straps to tighten and buckles to argue with.
Someone is expecting their mail patched before nightfall.
I promised to finish a cracked helm before dusk.
Best I get back before somebody walks around in loose armor.
I have tools to oil and steel to settle.
The forge is still <pulse>warm</pulse>. Shame to waste good heat.
You will know where to find me. I'll be near the anvil.
